item.description:
• Your kit sounds like the same person in the app and on Telegram, and the memories an answer came from now sit as footnotes underneath it instead of in the middle of sentences.
  • When your kit has no memories about something yet, it says so plainly and invites you to tell it, so it can remember for next time.
  • Starting a job shows its card straight away, so anything waiting for your approval is on screen from the first moment.
